title: AI stocks slide after Anthropic, OpenAI CEOs urge slowdown
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman both called for slowing AI development, sparking a broad global selloff in AI-related stocks. SK Hynix fell over 6%, Samsung slid 4%, SoftBank dropped 10%, and Nvidia declined ~3% pre-market. Nasdaq 100 futures fell 1.2%, S&P 500 futures lost 0.6%.
why: AI主题核心持仓（英伟达NVDA、SK海力士HBM相关）直接受压，SK海力士港股代理ETF（7709.HK两倍杠杆）波动放大；整体科技板块情绪恶化将提升相关期权隐含波动率，对卖期权策略需谨慎。

title: Satellite images show extent of damage to Saudi Arabia's oil pipeline that bypasses Strait of Hormuz
summary: Saudi Arabia shut its East-West oil pipeline (7 million barrels/day capacity) after drone attacks, with satellite images showing pump station damage. Brent crude rose 3.4% to $108.17 per barrel Monday; WTI rose 3% to $103.07, adding significant inflationary pressure.
why: 油价飙升加剧通胀压力，叠加美联储明日（9/16）利率决议，加息预期进一步强化；能源成本上行对消费/餐饮持仓（海底捞、麦当劳）构成成本压力；老铺黄金因避险属性或受益。

title: Stock market next week: Outlook for Sept. 14-18, 2026
summary: FOMC meets Sept. 15-16 with the rate decision due 2 PM ET Wednesday. Fed funds futures as of Sept. 11 priced in ~59% odds of a 25bp rate hike (CNBC), as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaled a hawkish tilt at Jackson Hole after markets had priced ~70% chance of holding steady. Retail sales and inflation data also due this week.
why: 延续报道：FOMC利率决议于明日（9/16）公布，是本周最大市场催化剂。59%概率来自CNBC 9/11引用的联邦基金期货定价；沙特油价冲击后概率或已进一步上升。加息落地将压制成长股估值，所有持仓须防范高波动风险。沃什（Kevin Warsh）为现任美联储主席，2026年5月就职。

title: Anthropic walks tightrope to Nasdaq, pushing for a slowdown while pursuing $2 trillion valuation
summary: CNBC reports Anthropic is pursuing a Nasdaq IPO targeting a $2 trillion valuation, even while calling for AI development slowdowns. If completed, this would rank among the largest tech IPOs in history.
why: Anthropic IPO将重新锚定AI板块估值参照系，对谷歌（GOOGL）、英伟达（NVDA）、Palantir（PLTR）等AI主题持仓有连带定价影响；超大规模IPO同时分流流动性，对期权卖权策略环境有影响。
